content.comment_body: Thank you for your suggestions. This might help, but I'm still unsure how to solve another issue: my simple web page, which controls home lights via push and switch buttons, loads very slowly. Is there any way to improve its performance?
No. The issue is due to the current [product_name] [version_no]. It's too slow for this type of functionality.
What is your web server configuration? Are you using HTTPS? If possible, switch the web server to HTTP mode, which might offer better performance.

analysis.insight_summary: A user observed very slow loading times on a simple HTML-based interface for controlling house lights from their controller. Other participants noted that this speed limitation is a known drawback of the [product_name] [version_no] hardware, and suggested trying HTTP instead of HTTPS to possibly increase responsiveness. Web interface sluggishness is a common issue when using web hosting features on this specific device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects their controller-hosted web interface to load promptly and deliver a seamless experience for controlling home lights.
